records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Hana,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, zero product activity: no project, no invite, no milestone, despite onboarding email [email:3104ad19], check-in [email:972de30e], and a held call [calendar:d2c2c3ca] with no customer reply. Team plan and the attended call suggest some intent, but silence after three touches makes unaided activation in 8 days unlikely.

draft.subject: Picking up where our call left off
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

Thanks again for making time for the getting started call last week. I know the first week gets busy, so here's the short version of where to pick up: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready to bring the rest of Lantern Logistics in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
